title: A profile of Anthropic as it prepares to go public and broaden access to Mythos, amid criticism that commercial pressures have eroded its AI safety standards (Madhumita Murgia/Financial Times)
summary: Madhumita Murgia / Financial Times: A profile of Anthropic as it prepares to go public and broaden access to Mythos, amid criticism that commercial pressures have eroded its AI safety standards — Can the AI company hold on to its ethical founding principles as it strides to market with its most powerful and unnerving tool yet?
